cards.text: The prophet Joel has been passing along the LORD's promises about the great and awesome Day of the LORD (Joel 2:31). Now the LORD speaks of the time when He restores Judah and Jerusalem from captivity. And friend, He's got plans for the nations too.

cards.question: When the LORD restores Judah and Jerusalem, what does He say He'll do with all the nations?

answers.text: Gather them down into one valley
Send them all home in peace

cards.text: He'll bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. And there, He says, He will enter into judgment against them.

cards.question: In the Valley of Jehoshaphat, what is the LORD judging the nations about?

answers.text: How they treated His people Israel
How they treated their own kings
How they ran their trade routes

cards.question: The nations scattered Israel and divided up the land. True or false: the LORD calls that land "My land."

cards.text: Then it gets hard to hear. They cast lots for His people, bartered a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine to drink.
Then the LORD calls out Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia BY NAME. He asks what they have against Him, and whether they're trying to pay Him back.

cards.question: If Tyre, Sidon and Philistia try to pay the LORD back, He says He'll take His time returning it on their heads. True or false?

cards.text: They took His silver and gold and carried off His finest treasures to their OWN temples. Friend, who DOES that?

cards.question: Tyre, Sidon and Philistia sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the ___, far from their homeland.

cards.text: Sent far from home. I think that one stings. But the LORD says, "Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them…"

cards.question: The LORD says He'll return their payback on their heads. What will happen to the sons and daughters of Tyre, Sidon and Philistia?

answers.text: They'll be sold to the people of Judah
They'll be carried off to Damascus
They'll be sent away to Cush

cards.question: Then the people of Judah will sell the sons and daughters of Tyre, Sidon and Philistia to the ___, a distant nation.

cards.text: And it's settled with this: "Indeed, the LORD has spoken." That's the end of the discussion, friend.
Now a message goes out, to be proclaimed among the nations. Prepare for war, rouse the mighty men, advance and attack!

cards.question: To get ready for this war, what are the nations told to do with their farm tools?

cards.text: Plowshares into swords, pruning hooks into spears. Even the weak are told to say, "I am strong!" which is me after ONE push-up.
All the surrounding nations are called to come quickly and gather. Then a voice turns to the LORD: "Bring down Your mighty ones, O LORD."

cards.question: The nations are called to advance to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, where the LORD says He will ___ to judge all the nations on every side.

cards.text: Then the picture turns to harvest. Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe, and trample the grapes, for the winepress is full.

cards.question: In this harvest picture, why do the wine vats overflow?

cards.text: Then the cry goes up: "Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision!" Packed in tighter than the line on free cookie day.

cards.question: In the valley of decision, the Day of the LORD is ___.
Then the prophecy says the sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine. True or false?

cards.text: The LORD will ROAR from Zion and raise His voice from Jerusalem. Heaven and earth will tremble.

cards.question: While heaven and earth tremble, what will the LORD be for His people?

answers.text: A judge watching from far away
A voice they can no longer hear

cards.text: A refuge and a stronghold, right in the middle of the shaking. Then the LORD says, "Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, My holy mountain."

cards.question: Jerusalem will be holy. True or false: someday foreigners will overrun it again.

cards.text: And in that day, the mountains will drip with sweet wine and the hills will flow with milk. Friend, my chocolate chip bin overflowed ONE time and I just stood there staring for an hour.

cards.question: All the streams of Judah run with water, and a spring flows out to water the Valley of Acacias. Where does that spring flow from?
Judah gets streams. But Egypt will become desolate, and Edom a desert wasteland. Why?

answers.text: Because of their violence against Judah
Because they turned Judah's messengers away
Because their own rivers dried up

cards.question: Egypt and Edom will be left desolate. But Judah will be inhabited ___.

cards.text: And Jerusalem, from generation to generation. Then the LORD says, "For I will avenge their blood, which I have not yet avenged."
And the last word is this: the LORD dwells in Zion.
